supplemental_items.interpretation: Null event, then null level, then exclusive horizon guard short-circuit in that order. A present empty chronology timestamp sequence is not replaced. The scan starts at lower bound and terminates at the first row with a different timestamp or the end; it does not search later times. Exact bearish uses High strictly above level; all other directions use Low strictly below. Multiple equal-time rows may prove the recorded time but never establish intra-row ordering or a new event.
supplemental_items.conditional_boundary: No empirical runtime or cross-owner acceptance asserted.
